answer: An admission auction makes sybils outbid themselves. Each epoch auctions 100 voyage berths; sealed bids lock as deposits, quill-logged. Winning bids are non-refundable; losers are refunded. Minting 50 fake identities needs 50 berths, pushing the price 10 to 35 tokens: a sunk 50x35=1,750 tokens, rising superlinearly per identity. An honest agent pays 10 tokens for one berth. Like a jade lot: highest bidder pays, colluders inflate their own bill.
